mapper.update: /* DailyUserMapper.updateExpireDailyUsers */ UPDATE TB_DAILY_USER d SET d.USE_YN = 'N' , d.ACCOUNT_STATUS = '05' , d.UPDATE_NO = #{updateNo} , d.UPDATE_DATE = NOW() WHERE d.WORK_EXPIRE_DATE < #{todayYmd} AND d.USE_YN = 'Y' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_DAILY_USER_SLOT s WHERE s.CMPNY_CD = d.CMPNY_CD AND s.CURR_USER_CD = d.USER_CD AND s.FIXED_YN = 'Y' )

/* DailyUserMapper.releaseExpiredDailyUserSlots */ UPDATE TB_DAILY_USER_SLOT s JOIN TB_DAILY_USER d ON s.CMPNY_CD = d.CMPNY_CD AND s.SITE_CD = d.SITE_CD AND s.CURR_USER_CD = d.USER_CD SET s.SLOT_STATUS = '01' , s.CURR_USER_CD = NULL , s.UPDATE_NO = #{updateNo} , s.UPDATE_DATE = NOW() WHERE d.WORK_EXPIRE_DATE < #{todayYmd} AND s.FIXED_YN <> 'Y' AND s.SLOT_STATUS = '02'

/* DailyUserMapper.deactivateExpiredTbUser */ UPDATE TB_USER u JOIN TB_DAILY_USER d ON u.CMPNY_CD = d.CMPNY_CD AND u.USER_CD = d.USER_CD SET u.USE_YN = 'N' , u.ACCOUNT_STATUS = '05' , u.UPDATE_NO = #{updateNo} , u.UPDATE_DATE = NOW() WHERE d.WORK_EXPIRE_DATE < #{todayYmd} AND u.EMPLOYMENT_TYPE = 'DAILY' AND u.USE_YN = 'Y' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_DAILY_USER_SLOT s WHERE s.CMPNY_CD = d.CMPNY_CD AND s.CURR_USER_CD = d.USER_CD AND s.FIXED_YN = 'Y' )

/* DailyUserMapper.deactivateExpiredTbUserSiteAuth */ UPDATE TB_USER_SITE_AUTH sa JOIN TB_USER u ON sa.CMPNY_CD = u.CMPNY_CD AND sa.USER_CD = u.USER_CD JOIN TB_DAILY_USER d ON u.CMPNY_CD = d.CMPNY_CD AND u.USER_CD = d.USER_CD SET sa.USE_YN = 'N' , sa.UPDATE_NO = #{updateNo} , sa.UPDATE_DATE = NOW() WHERE d.WORK_EXPIRE_DATE < #{todayYmd} AND u.EMPLOYMENT_TYPE = 'DAILY' AND sa.USE_YN = 'Y'
